tasks.short: Attend performance fittings, photography and makeup calls

steps.what: Check the actual current costume fitting, photography session or makeup call time and location
inputs: Production team's actual current call sheet and calendar entry
outputs: Dancer knows the actual current call requirements

steps.what: Attend and participate in the actual costume fitting, photography session or makeup call for the performance
inputs: Actual dancer, costumes, photographer or makeup staff
outputs: Dancer participates in the actual fitting, photographs or makeup preparation

tasks.design: Retain the existing {CALENDAR} entry and {DOCS} call sheet. The dancer checks the current call and attends the actual physical session; no new software change is established for this work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task requires the actual dancer to be present for fitting, photography or makeup.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing call sheets already provide the time and location; no additional labor-saving mechanism is established here.
tasks.still_hard: Clothing fit, physical appearance and actual participation require the dancer.
tasks.human_edge: The dancer provides the actual physical presence and responds to the production staff.

ambition.what: No new change proposed for actual session attendance.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an existing call sheet can state a session's time and location but does not replace the dancer's physical participation.

assumptions: Unmeasured actual attendance episode; shares are independently sized and do not use the prompt prior.
Production staff produce the actual call sheet; s1 explicitly counts the dancer's current-call check. The current calendar entry already works, so no new retrieval or scheduling saving is assumed.

Wardrobe staff, photographer or makeup staff may create their own measurements, images or notes during s2; those are their actual work, not a missing dancer write. No dancer-authored report, acceptance transaction, follow-up message or separate call confirmation is established in this episode.
After separating the actual lookup from physical participation, neither has an established new saving. No extra record or approval ceremony is invented. Gross and net change are both zero.
unknowns: Whether a particular production requires a separate dancer confirmation or record
research_questions: Does the dancer actually perform any additional record or send action beyond attending this call?

already_counted.description: Existing current-call lookup retained in full

incremental.description: No implementation or new upkeep is proposed because existing calls and physical attendance remain unchanged

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured assessment: current-call check 5 and actual participation 95 are both retained; no new work, gross 0 and net 0.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find actual current performances, dance publications and professional programs relevant to the dancer's interests
inputs: OTHER: existing dance publication and performance catalogues

steps.what: Watch actual dance performances and recordings to assess movement, style and innovation
outputs: Dancer's actual observations of movement and style

steps.what: Read and critically assess actual dance commentary and professional publications
outputs: Dancer's actual understanding of published discussion

steps.what: Discuss actual trends and innovations with dance colleagues
outputs: Actual professional exchange and artistic understanding

tasks.design: Configure native saved searches and topic filters in {OTHER} for actual dance publications and performance programs. Keep watching, reading, artistic interpretation and colleague discussion with the dancer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source searches add handling before actual artistic observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue filters can reuse the dancer's actual topic and genre choices.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding movement, artistic quality and meaningful innovation requires watching and participating in the field.
tasks.human_edge: The dancer assesses how actual movement and performance relate to artistic practice.

ambition.what: Reduce retrieval around existing awareness of the dance field.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native catalogue filters can reduce repeated retrieval of actual dance sources while artistic observation and interpretation remain human.

assumptions: Unmeasured current-awareness episode; shares are independent of the prompt prior and are not a universal mix of live viewing and publications.

Performers, publishers and organizers supply actual programs, recordings and texts. s1 counts locating and checking actual sources; s2-s4 count actual observation, reading and discussion. No generated performance, title or trend claim is assumed.

No separate trend report, social post, booking, purchased ticket or follow-up message is established in this episode. Such actions are not invented or silently automated. Native filters come first; existing equivalent searches earn no new benefit.
Gross 7 minus 1 upkeep gives 6 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual search effort and current filters
research_questions: Which catalogue searches are repeated manually?

already_counted.description: Retained source retrieval, actual viewing and critical reading

incremental.description: Maintain actual topic filters and periodically check source coverage

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 20 times 35% = 7 gross retrieval reduction, minus 1 upkeep = 6 net. Actual artistic observation remains retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Plan the actual lesson for the students' experience, learning needs and available studio
inputs: Actual student learning needs and prior progress
Actual lesson purpose and studio constraints
outputs: Teacher's actual lesson choices and structure

steps.what: Retrieve and check the actual previously used teaching material or music references for the planned lesson
inputs: OTHER: existing studio teaching-material and music-reference library
outputs: Checked existing material ready for the lesson

steps.what: Teach the actual dance lesson, demonstrate movement and respond to students' actual practice
outputs: Actual instruction, observed student practice and participation

steps.what: Capture actual attendance and the required lesson-progress entry and check its complete final content
inputs: Actual observed participation and progress from s3

steps.what: Save the exact checked class entry after actual teaching and participation
inputs: Exact final class entry checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual attendance and required lesson-progress record

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} and {OTHER} material links and existing {OPS_SYSTEM} class-register fields. Keep lesson planning, actual teaching and observed-progress capture with the dancer, then check and save the actual completed class entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searching known lesson material and repeating class-record headings adds minor handling to teaching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native library links and studio-register forms can reuse existing material locations and record structure.
tasks.still_hard: Demonstration, feedback, student understanding and physical practice require the teacher and students.
tasks.human_edge: The dancer sees actual movement and adapts teaching to students' needs.

ambition.what: Reduce minor material and record handling around actual dance teaching.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: material-library links and native class-register forms can reduce retrieval and repeated structure while actual dance teaching remains human.

assumptions: Unmeasured studio lesson with an actual required attendance/progress entry, not an invented report after every demonstration. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

s1 counts actual planning, s2 actual existing-material retrieval and checking, s3 actual teaching and observed practice, and s4 actual participation capture and complete final entry checking. No free complete lesson or generated student assessment is assumed.
The entry follows actual class participation; no attendance or completion is entered beforehand. It does not grant a qualification or trigger a hidden payment or student message.
Use native links and forms first; equivalent existing capabilities earn no new gain. Same-system save is immediate with no saving. Gross 3.4 minus 1 upkeep gives 2.4 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual studio record requirements and current forms
research_questions: Which repeated class-record fields remain manual?

already_counted.description: Retained material checking and actual final class-entry capture and verification

incremental.description: Maintain existing-material links and actual class-register headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete class entry based on actual participation checked in s4; changed participation or observations require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 2 retrieval plus 1.4 record-heading hours = 3.4 gross, minus 1 upkeep = 2.4 net. Actual teaching remains retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Devise the actual dance concept, structure and movement ideas for self or others
inputs: Actual performers, music context and performance constraints
outputs: Dancer's actual choreographic ideas and structure

steps.what: Develop and rehearse actual movement phrases, transitions and spatial relationships
inputs: Actual dancer or collaborating performers and space
outputs: Actual developed choreography and revision decisions

steps.what: Capture the actual phrase order, counts and staging decisions in the dancer's existing choreography notes
Check the complete final choreography notes against the actual movement and intended sequence
inputs: Actual developed choreography and staging decisions

steps.what: Save the exact checked choreography notes in the existing document workspace
inputs: Exact final notes checked in s4

tasks.design: Configure reusable phrase and staging headings in the dancer's existing {DOCS} choreography notes. Keep invention, physical movement development, actual note capture and complete final checking with the dancer before saving the exact notes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated note headings add minor handling while recording actual choreography.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document sections can reuse the existing note structure without inventing movement.
tasks.still_hard: Movement invention, embodied refinement and artistic relationships require the dancer and performers.
tasks.human_edge: The dancer creates the work and judges how it actually moves.

ambition.what: Reduce minor structural note handling in actual choreography.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reusable document sections can reduce repeated choreography-note headings while the dancer invents and checks all actual movement content.

assumptions: Unmeasured choreographic episode with actual existing phrase/staging notes, not extra paperwork invented after every rehearsal. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.
s1 and s2 count actual creative work and physical refinement. s3 counts actual phrase, count and staging capture; no free complete choreography or generated dance sequence is assumed.

Only repeated note structure is simplified. s4 checks the complete final notes against actual movement. Existing equivalent note sections earn no new benefit and the same-system save is immediate with no saving.

No automated performer evaluation, movement generation, music licensing, public release or performer message is hidden in saving the notes. Gross 2 minus 1 upkeep gives 1 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Actual note-taking practice and existing structure
research_questions: Are repeated note headings a real source of effort?

already_counted.description: Retained actual choreography capture and complete final note checking

incremental.description: Maintain the dancer's small existing-note structure

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete choreography notes checked in s4; changed movement or notation requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 20 times 10% = 2 gross note-structure hours, minus 1 upkeep = 1 net. Creative and physical choreographic work remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Production staff provide actual calls and retain their own fitting, photography and makeup work.
Students and collaborating performers participate in actual teaching and creative work.
skills_to_grow: Maintain actual source and material links
Keep note structure distinct from artistic content
role.ambitious_version: A dancer with modestly easier source and record handling while retaining physical participation, teaching and creative authorship.
